import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc = bpy.context.scene

def mat(name, col, rough=0.5, metal=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = next(n for n in m.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    b.inputs[0].default_value = (*col, 1)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    m.diffuse_color = (*col, 1)
    return m

M = dict(asphalt=mat("Asphalt",(0.05,0.05,0.055),0.9), grass=mat("Grass",(0.08,0.3,0.06),1),
         red=mat("CurbRed",(0.8,0.05,0.03)), white=mat("CurbWhite",(0.9,0.9,0.9)),
         body=mat("CarBody",(0.02,0.35,0.8),0.3,0.4), accent=mat("CarAccent",(1.0,0.55,0.0),0.4),
         tire=mat("Tire",(0.02,0.02,0.02),0.8), glass=mat("Glass",(0.02,0.03,0.05),0.1),
         line=mat("Line",(0.95,0.95,0.95),0.6))

# centerline: straight, 90deg left-to-right corner, straight
pts = []
for i in range(0, 31, 2): pts.append(Vector((0, -40 + i, 0)))         # (0,-40)->(0,-10)
R = 15; c = Vector((R, -10, 0))
for i in range(1, 25):
    a = math.pi - (math.pi/2)*i/24
    pts.append(c + Vector((R*math.cos(a), R*math.sin(a), 0)))          # ends at (15,5)
for i in range(2, 41, 2): pts.append(Vector((15 + i, 5, 0)))           # ->(55,5)

def tangent(i):
    a = pts[max(i-1,0)]; b = pts[min(i+1,len(pts)-1)]
    return (b-a).normalized()

def ribbon(name, off_in, off_out, z, m, checker=None):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm = bmesh.new()
    rows = []
    for i,p in enumerate(pts):
        t = tangent(i); n = Vector((-t.y, t.x, 0))
        rows.append((bm.verts.new(p + n*off_in + Vector((0,0,z))), bm.verts.new(p + n*off_out + Vector((0,0,z)))))
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        f = bm.faces.new((rows[i][0], rows[i][1], rows[i+1][1], rows[i+1][0]))
        if checker: f.material_index = i % 2
    bm.normal_update()
    for f in bm.faces:
        if f.normal.z < 0: f.normal_flip()
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me); sc.collection.objects.link(o)
    for mm in (checker or [m]): me.materials.append(mm)
    return o

W = 5
ribbon("Track", -W, W, 0.0, M['asphalt'])
ribbon("Curb_L", W, W+1, 0.03, None, [M['red'], M['white']])
ribbon("Curb_R", -W-1, -W, 0.03, None, [M['red'], M['white']])
# dashed center line
me = bpy.data.meshes.new("CenterLine"); bm = bmesh.new()
for i in range(0, len(pts)-1, 2):
    a, b = pts[i], pts[i+1]; t = (b-a).normalized(); n = Vector((-t.y,t.x,0))*0.12; z=Vector((0,0,0.02))
    bm.faces.new([bm.verts.new(v+z) for v in (a-n, a+n, b+n, b-n)])
bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
o = bpy.data.objects.new("CenterLine", me); sc.collection.objects.link(o); me.materials.append(M['line'])

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=200, location=(10,-10,-0.02))
g = bpy.context.object; g.name = "Grass"; g.data.materials.append(M['grass'])

# path curve for car
cd = bpy.data.curves.new("RacePath", 'CURVE'); cd.dimensions = '3D'
sp = cd.splines.new('POLY'); sp.points.add(len(pts)-1)
for i,p in enumerate(pts): sp.points[i].co = (p.x, p.y, 0, 1)
path = bpy.data.objects.new("RacePath", cd); sc.collection.objects.link(path)
path.hide_render = True
print(len(pts), cd.splines[0].calc_length())

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc = bpy.context.scene
M = bpy.data.materials
car = bpy.data.objects.new("RaceCar", None); sc.collection.objects.link(car)
car.empty_display_type = 'ARROWS'

def poly(name, verts, faces, m):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name); me.from_pydata(verts, [], faces); me.update()
    me.materials.append(m)
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me); sc.collection.objects.link(o); o.parent = car
    return o

def box(name, x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1, m, taper_front=0.0, top_front=None):
    zf = z1 if top_front is None else top_front
    v = [(x0,y0,z0),(x1,y0,z0),(x1,y1,z0),(x0,y1,z0),
         (x0+taper_front,y0,z1) if False else (x0,y0,z1),(x1,y0,z1),(x1-taper_front,y1,zf),(x0+taper_front,y1,zf)]
    f = [(0,3,2,1),(4,5,6,7),(0,1,5,4),(2,3,7,6),(1,2,6,5),(3,0,4,7)]
    return poly(name, v, f, m)

# main wedge body: rear high, nose low and narrow
box("Body", -0.9,0.9, -2.0,1.2, 0.18,0.62, M['CarBody'], taper_front=0.0)
box("Nose", -0.9,0.9, 1.2,2.3, 0.18,0.45, M['CarBody'], taper_front=0.35, top_front=0.25)
# canopy: angular wedge
poly("Canopy", [(-0.55,-0.9,0.62),(0.55,-0.9,0.62),(0.5,0.7,0.62),(-0.5,0.7,0.62),
                (-0.42,-0.6,0.98),(0.42,-0.6,0.98),(0.3,0.15,0.95),(-0.3,0.15,0.95)],
     [(4,5,6,7),(0,1,5,4),(2,3,7,6),(1,2,6,5),(3,0,4,7)], M['Glass'])
# side pods (accent)
box("SidePod_L", -1.05,-0.9, -1.4,0.6, 0.22,0.5, M['CarAccent'])
box("SidePod_R", 0.9,1.05, -1.4,0.6, 0.22,0.5, M['CarAccent'])
# stripe on top
box("Stripe", -0.18,0.18, -2.0,2.25, 0.62,0.635, M['CarAccent'])
# rear wing
box("WingStrut_L", -0.6,-0.5, -1.9,-1.7, 0.62,1.05, M['CarBody'])
box("WingStrut_R", 0.5,0.6, -1.9,-1.7, 0.62,1.05, M['CarBody'])
box("RearWing", -1.0,1.0, -2.15,-1.6, 1.05,1.12, M['CarAccent'])
# front splitter
box("Splitter", -1.0,1.0, 1.9,2.45, 0.12,0.18, M['CarAccent'])

# wheels
for nm,(x,y) in {"FL":(0.98,1.4),"FR":(-0.98,1.4),"RL":(0.98,-1.3),"RR":(-0.98,-1.3)}.items():
    r = 0.38 if nm[0]=='R' else 0.34
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=10, radius=r, depth=0.32, location=(x,y,r), rotation=(0,math.pi/2,0))
    w = bpy.context.object; w.name = "Wheel_"+nm; w.data.materials.append(M['Tire']); w.parent = car
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=6, radius=r*0.5, depth=0.34, location=(x,y,r), rotation=(0,math.pi/2,0))
    h = bpy.context.object; h.name = "Hub_"+nm; h.data.materials.append(M['CarAccent']); h.parent = car

# flat shading everywhere for low-poly look
for o in car.children:
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth = False

# follow path
con = car.constraints.new('FOLLOW_PATH'); con.target = bpy.data.objects['RacePath']
con.use_curve_follow = True; con.use_fixed_location = True
con.forward_axis = 'FORWARD_Y'; con.up_axis = 'UP_Z'
con.offset_factor = 0.0; car.keyframe_insert('constraints["Follow Path"].offset_factor', frame=1)
con.offset_factor = 1.0; car.keyframe_insert('constraints["Follow Path"].offset_factor', frame=120)
for fc in car.animation_data.action.fcurves if hasattr(car.animation_data.action,'fcurves') else []:
    for k in fc.keyframe_points: k.interpolation = 'LINEAR'
print(car.animation_data.action)

sc = bpy.context.scene
car = bpy.data.objects['RaceCar']

fcs = list(getattr(act,'fcurves',[]) or [])
if not fcs:
    for l in act.layers:
        for s in l.strips:
            for cb in s.channelbags: fcs += list(cb.fcurves)
for fc in fcs:
    for k in fc.keyframe_points: k.interpolation = 'LINEAR'
print(len(fcs))
cam = bpy.data.objects['Camera']; cam.name = "ChaseCam"

cam.parent = car; cam.matrix_parent_inverse.identity()

cam.data.lens = 32
sc.camera = cam
sc.frame_start, sc.frame_end = 1, 120
sc.render.fps = 24; sc.render.fps_base = 1
sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y, sc.render.resolution_percentage = 1280, 720, 100
print(sc.render.engine, [i.identifier for i in bpy.types.RenderSettings.bl_rna.properties['engine'].enum_items])
